 $$ \begin{array}{l} \therefore \int \frac {d x}{(1 + x) \sqrt {1 - x - x ^ {2}}} = - \int \frac {d z}{z ^ {2} \frac {1}{z} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{z} - \frac {1}{z ^ {2}}}} \\ = - \int \frac {d z}{\sqrt {z ^ {2} + z - 1}} = - \int \frac {d z}{\sqrt {\left(z + \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} - \frac {5}{4}}} \\ = - \log \left\{\sqrt {z ^ {2} + z - 1} + z + \frac {1}{2} \right\} \\ = - \log \left\{\frac {\sqrt {1 - x - x ^ {2}}}{1 + x} + \frac {1}{1 + x} + \frac {1}{2} \right\} \\ = - \log \left\{\frac {2 \sqrt {1 - x - x ^ {2}} + x + 3}{2 (1 + x)} \right\} \\ = \log \left\{\frac {2 (1 + \bar {x})}{2 \sqrt {1 - x - x ^ {2}} + x + 3} \right\} \\ = \log \left\{\frac {2 (1 + x) (x + 3) - 2 \sqrt {1 - x - x ^ {2}}}{x ^ {2} + 6 x + 9 - 4 + 4 x + 4 x ^ {2}} \right\}. \\ = \log \frac {2 (1 + x) (x + 3 - 2 \sqrt {1 - x - x ^ {2}})}{5 (1 + x) ^ {2}} \\ = \log \frac {x + 3 - 2 \sqrt {1 - x - x ^ {2}}}{1 + x} + c. \\ \end{array} $$
